::: {.page-title-band}
# About
:::

```{=html}
<div class="about-hero">
  <div class="about-hero-image">
    <img src="../assets/images/pexels-herry-11466481.jpg" alt="Apple on tree"/>
  </div>
  <div class="about-hero-text">
    <p>FruitMeasureApp is a mobile application based on artificial intelligence designed to estimate fruit size directly from smartphone images, supporting decision-making in precision agriculture.</p>
    <p>This solution has been developed in the framework of a research and demonstration project focused on validating and transferring AI-based tools to the fruit sector.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```

::: {.section-dark}
::: {.section-inner--wide}

## Project status

- Active research and development project (2024–2026).
- Mobile application published for public use.
- Includes model inference and training pipelines.

:::
